source: Where these codes came from, e.g. the client's last posted wages journal in Xero (month/year), so the next person can check them.
notes: mode: shadow = build + reconcile only; draft = create a DRAFT in Xero for a human to approve; post = create it POSTED.
Never guess a nominal code. Copy it from the client's own posted wages journal. Leave it empty or 'TBC-...' and the run HOLDs.
One-off corrections seen in an old journal are not standing rules - do not replicate them here.
